title: [P0] TANAW-01: Shared vocabulary, contracts and local integration foundation
goal: Developer 1 / Lead integration lane: establish the approved tanaw-v1 32-card shared vocabulary, pinned React/Vite and FastAPI foundations, loopback startup, and configured product verification. Sessions use the approved planning package; this kickoff does not execute implementation.
module: shared/vocabulary.json; frontend/backend manifests; local startup; existing verification configuration
acceptance_criteria: One canonical vocabulary implements the approved 32 IDs, labels, order and local symbol/audio paths; frontend bundles it and backend consumes the same version.
Approved API envelope, revisions, vocabulary checks, limits and speech interface are frozen before parallel integration; no cloud/auth/database/microphone scope is added.
Development proxy and final FastAPI static serving run on loopback; documented locked setup and startup work on the demo laptop.
Existing verification.commands and CI cover applicable product tests/build; existing harness and security checks remain intact.
Already-loaded direct AAC survives inference API/backend failure; disconnected page reload works with the local server running.

definition_of_ready.common: Architecture and compact plan approved; actual owner and independent reviewer supplied; approved planning package available. Do not infer identities.
definition_of_ready.task: Shared contract specification is available. Coordinate manifest/shared-file changes with the other lanes. Current Backlog reason: missing real owner/reviewer; planning docs remain local/uncommitted.

owner_specialty: Developer 1: Lead Architect / integration / shared contracts
reviewers: Developer 3 reviews shared/backend setup; Developer 4 reviews startup/verification; actual reviewer identities pending
exit_evidence: Shared vocabulary/version checks, configured product checks/build, loopback startup and disconnected reload evidence, independent PASS review.

title: [P0] TANAW-06: Editable Figma foundation and human design review
goal: Developer 2 design lane: generate an editable Figma foundation from the approved docs/design/ux-plan.md brief, then obtain explicit human review before frontend implementation. This separates design preparation from the design-gated TANAW-02 task.
module: Figma design; docs/design/ux-plan.md; existing design-system/wireframe handoff
acceptance_criteria: Editable Communicate, Review Message and Conversation screen families include required empty/loading/error/approval/AI/speech-unavailable states.
Shared shell preserves board positions and complete vocabulary access; suggestions never hide/rearrange cards or select/speak a response.
Laptop/tablet/phone variants and reusable labeled card/action/message components follow approved contrast, target-size, focus and reduced-motion rules.
Record actual Figma link/node references, human reviewer/date and explicit approval or corrections; no frontend UI code is written before approval.

definition_of_ready.common: Architecture and compact plan approved; actual owner and independent reviewer supplied; approved planning package available.
definition_of_ready.task: Approved UX brief available, Figma access confirmed, human reviewer available. Design generation is preparation; it is not final design approval. Current Backlog reason: missing owner/reviewer/access confirmation.

reviewers: Developer 4 read-only accessibility/state review plus Lead Architect/human final design approval; actual identities pending
exit_evidence: Editable Figma link, three screen families and states, responsive review, explicit human design approval/correction record.

title: [P0] TANAW-02: Accessible board, message construction and approval flow
goal: Developer 2 frontend lane: implement the human-approved Figma communication shell, stable picture board, ordered message construction and explicit review/Speak states, integrating the independently owned speech helper.
module: frontend communication board, message state, review/conversation views and accessibility
acceptance_criteria: Use the approved tanaw-v1 IDs/order; selection appends in tap order, duplicates remain intentional, maximum 12 cards, Undo/remove/Clear work without drag-only interaction.
No/Stop/Help/Repeat/Something else and full vocabulary stay accessible; AI results never reorder/hide the board.
Card/question edits invalidate late responses and candidate approval; original wording remains visible; approving/editing never automatically speaks.
Explicit Speak uses the speech interface; direct selection/speech remains available during model failure/inference.
Approved responsive layouts, labeled symbols, keyboard/focus, contrast, target sizing and truthful loading/error/speech-failure states pass focused Design QA.

definition_of_ready.common: Architecture/plan approved, actual owner/reviewer supplied, approved planning package available.
definition_of_ready.task: TANAW-06 human design approval recorded. Shared contracts are available; integrate TANAW-01 vocabulary/build and TANAW-04 speech incrementally rather than waiting for all AI work. Current Backlog reasons: design approval and actual owner/reviewer missing.

reviewers: Developer 1 code review; Developer 4 independent rendered Design QA; actual identities pending
exit_evidence: Frontend interaction tests/build, keyboard/responsive/failure-state checks, integrated direct speech and independent PASS/Design QA evidence.

title: [P0] TANAW-03: Local model feasibility and validated sentence expansion
goal: Developer 3 backend/local-AI lane: benchmark a small local Ollama model, then implement health/expansion and conservative meaning-preserving validation. Real model inference must be distinguished from deterministic baseline AAC or mocks.
module: backend communication validation, runtime adapter, health/expand endpoints and local AI evaluation
acceptance_criteria: Start with a small local model (qwen3:1.7b candidate), pin tested runtime/model digest, measure cold/warm latency and RAM/VRAM without assuming acceleration/performance.
Actual inference works after internet disconnection and restart; no cloud model, remote fallback, tools or prompt/message logging.

Request JSON schema and validate exact source IDs plus approved Want/Not-Want grammar; unsupported sequences retain direct wording; no accepted invented needs/preferences/negation changes in fixtures.
Implement version/revision/error contracts, one active call, five-second deadline, and unavailable/busy/invalid-output paths; baseline AAC remains usable.

At least 12 expansion fixtures and 30 timed warm calls: supported expansion success >=90%, no accepted unsupported additions, warm p95 target <=3 seconds. Report failed gates; never silently weaken them.

definition_of_ready.common: Architecture/plan approved; actual owner/reviewer supplied; approved planning package available.
definition_of_ready.task: Approved grammar/API specification and demonstration-laptop access available. Runtime/model downloads occur only in an authorized implementation session. Model feasibility can start before TANAW-01 setup completes; coordinate backend manifests with Developer 1. Current Backlog reason: missing real owner/reviewer and device access confirmation.

reviewers: Developer 1 independent contract/security review; Developer 4 witnesses meaning/offline checks; actual identities pending
exit_evidence: Dated model/runtime/latency/memory report, real disconnected inference, grammar/contract/failure tests, independent PASS. Suggestions remain disabled.

title: [P0] TANAW-04: Offline speech proof, card-audio fallback and demo QA
goal: Developer 4 offline-speech/QA/demo lane: first verify offline speech on the demonstration laptop, then provide the speech helper and licensed card recordings, and collect integrated fresh-setup/demo evidence.
module: frontend speech helper and local audio/assets; QA, setup and demo/submission evidence
acceptance_criteria: First checkpoint records demo browser/installed local voice, actual full-sentence playback with internet disconnected, and stop/replay behavior; report missing voice as a blocker.
Provide speakText/speakCards/stopSpeech and capability/error state; use only local synthesis, with complete licensed/team-recorded clips for all 32 card IDs.
Clip fallback speaks selected labels in order and never silently substitutes different audio for approved/edited full text; all-speech-unavailable state is truthful.
Integrate with TANAW-02 after design approval; direct AAC works with Ollama stopped and an already loaded page continues when backend inference fails.
Final fresh setup/disconnected restart/reload, accessibility/fallback review, video/rehearsal and pre-existing harness/model/library/asset/tool disclosures identify the actual integrated build.

definition_of_ready.common: Architecture/plan approved; actual owner/reviewer supplied; approved planning package available.
definition_of_ready.task: Demo-laptop access and shared IDs/speech interface available. Standalone speech proof can start before frontend design; UI wiring waits for TANAW-06. Final QA/video waits for the integrated TANAW-01/02/03 build. Current Backlog reason: missing actual owner/reviewer/device access confirmation.

reviewers: Developer 2 independently reviews speech code; Developer 1 reviews QA/demo evidence; actual identities pending
exit_evidence: Disconnected voice and 32-card clip evidence, playback/error checks, independent review, fresh setup, verified demo/video and submission disclosures.

title: [P1 conditional] TANAW-05: Validated fixed-vocabulary conversation suggestions
goal: Developer 3 backend lane, with Developer 2 separately owned approved UI wiring: evaluate and enable typed-question card suggestions only after technical and Lead acceptance gates pass. Omit from the working demo if gates fail or threaten the P0/freeze buffer.
module: backend suggest endpoint/evaluation; approved frontend companion panel
acceptance_criteria: Typed question produces zero-to-six unique known tanaw-v1 IDs only, never free-form answers or automatic choices/speech; an empty result is valid.
At least 12 question fixtures include relevance, refusal/ambiguity, out-of-vocabulary content and prompt injection; independent relevance >=90%, all returned IDs valid, no imposed child response.
Latency/deadline, stale-question, unavailable/busy/invalid-output and disconnected-runtime tests pass; original primary board and essential responses stay accessible.
Record Lead acceptance of evaluation before enabling; human-approved UI remains separately gated. If any required gate fails, feature stays disabled.

definition_of_ready.common: Architecture/plan approved, actual owner/reviewer supplied, approved planning package available.
definition_of_ready.task: TANAW-03 usable model evidence accepted; P0/freeze buffer protected. Lead review of suggestion evaluation is mandatory before enabling, TANAW-06 human design approval before frontend wiring. Current Backlog reasons: prerequisites/evaluation missing and real owners/reviewers not supplied.

owner_specialty: Developer 3: Backend / Local AI; Developer 2 owns frontend wiring without transferring backend ownership
reviewers: Developer 1 reviews backend/gate; Developer 4 independently reviews relevance/safety/UI; actual identities pending
exit_evidence: Independent fixture/latency/offline report, explicit Lead enablement acceptance, valid-ID/stable-board checks and independent PASS; otherwise disabled.
